definitions.name: S0D.RUNSTARTS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND I 0 EQ NOT V I GET V I 1 SUB GET SUB 0 EQ AND NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> indices where a maximal run of equal adjacent values starts (index 0 always included)

definitions.name: S0D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 1 X RANGE [ 'D' BIND X D DIV RATIO 1 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> its positive divisors ascending

definitions.name: S0D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it has exactly two divisors

definitions.name: S0D.BRSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A CHARS 'AC' BIND '?' 1 COLLECT AC CONCAT -1 GET 'T' BIND '(' '[' C ')' EQ SELECT T EQ 'MATCH' BIND AC AC LENGTH 1 SUB 0 MAX TAKE JOIN A '!' 2 COLLECT JOIN MATCH SELECT 'CLOSED' BIND A C 2 COLLECT JOIN CLOSED '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step for bracket matching: open-stack String, bracket char -> new stack; an opener is pushed, a matching closer pops, a bad closer appends a permanent '!' so the stack is '' at the end iff balanced

definitions.name: S0D.CANCEL
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A CHARS 'AC' BIND '?' 1 COLLECT AC CONCAT -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'PAIR' BIND AC AC LENGTH 1 SUB 0 MAX TAKE JOIN A C 2 COLLECT JOIN PAIR '()' EQ NOT PAIR '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD step for deleting adjacent matched pairs: stack String, char -> stack with the char pushed, or the top popped when top+char is '()' or '[]'

solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V S0D.RUNSTARTS 'S' BIND V S GET S 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT S SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP SUB 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 E 0 GT SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 1 ADD
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES 'C' BIND C ORDER -1 GET 'M' BIND T KEYS M GET NIL C M GET 2 MUL N GT SELECT
solutions.number.binary: 'N' BIND 0 N RANGE [ 'K' BIND 2 K POW N GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 SUB 0 RANGE [ 'K' BIND N 2 K POW DIV FLOOR 2 DIV RATIO 1 GET 1 SUB STR ] MAP JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'N' BIND 1 300 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'J' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C S 2 COLLECT C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 DIV RATIO 1 GET 1 EQ SELECT S 1 ADD 2 COLLECT C 1 EQ SELECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.number.digital_root: 1 SUB 'M' BIND M M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
solutions.number.fib_index: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE 0 1 2 COLLECT [ 'J' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS '' [ S0D.BRSTEP ] SCAN [ '' EQ ] MAP 'M' BIND M 0 [ 'X' BIND 1 ADD ] SCAN 0 M SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
